definitions.explanation: The direction where the sun rises.

examples.japanese: {太陽|たいよう}は{東|ひがし}から{昇|のぼ}る。
examples.english: The sun rises from the east.

examples.japanese: {東|ひがし}{口|ぐち}で{待|ま}っています。
examples.english: I'll wait at the east exit.

notes: Cardinal directions: {東|ひがし} (east), {西|にし} (west), {南|みなみ} (south), {北|きた} (north).
